{{otheruses|information about the various tools and weapons used when fighting Slayer monsters|the slayer equipment shop operated by Slayer Masters|Slayer Equipment (shop)|gear suggestions for general slayer tasks|Slayer training#Equipment}}
'''Slayer equipment''' refers to various tools and weapons used when fighting [[Slayer monsters]]. When [[Slayer|slaying]] monsters, it is often required to use a specific piece of equipment to protect oneself from negative effects or to finish off a monster at low health. All [[Slayer master]]s run a [[Slayer Equipment (shop)|Slayer Equipment]] shop, selling the same items at the same price.
